subject: Nimbus Accelerator — sponsorship promo & IO for upcoming cohort
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina@NimbusAccelerator.org>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 08:18:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus cohort promo request — cohort starting Feb 1

Hi Olga,

Hope you had a good weekend. Quick ask: Nimbus Accelerator is kicking off its Feb cohort (30 early-stage teams) and we'd love Redwood to be the official inference partner again. Historically partners provide promotional credits (covering first 3 months of usage) and we co-market the cohort.

Specifics:
- Cohort start: 2027-02-01
- Expected enrolled teams using Redwood: ~20 active projects
- Promo ask: $10,000 in promotional credits applied to accounts across the cohort (distributed as $500–$800 per team depending on usage).
- Co-marketing: logo on cohort page + 1 webinar slot.

Attached is the cohort sponsor pack (nimbus-cohort-pack.pdf) with partner benefits and timeline. We can sign a simple IO. We need confirmation by Jan 14 to include you in the cohort announcement.

Can you advise next steps / who on your side should sign the IO?

Thanks — Nina
Nina Patel
Partnerships, Nimbus Accelerator
partners@nimbusaccelerator.org

Attachment: nimbus-cohort-pack.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@NimbusAccelerator.org>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus cohort promo request — cohort starting Feb 1

Nina — thanks for the deck and the heads up. Happy to support; a few quick clarifying questions so I can route to Procurement and Partnerships Ops: 

1) Do you need a single pooled credit allocation we mark on the cohort accounts, or individual coupons per team?
2) Is the cohort applying for extended trial windows (we typically do 30 days) or strictly promo credits?
3) Can you share the IO template you prefer — we can do a short sponsorship IO and a matching credit note.

Camila / Marissa / Marcus — looping you in for visibility. If we can confirm by EOD Thu (Jan 14) I can get Procurement to issue an IO and Ops to provision the promo codes. Suggested path: match up to $8k from Redwood + contribution from Nimbus for co-marketing? Open to your guidance on amount.

Thanks,
Olga
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus cohort promo request — cohort starting Feb 1

All — happy to support Nimbus on this cohort. Approving a promotional allocation of up to $7,500 from Redwood, subject to IO and standard promo terms (30-day trial extension by default; credits expire after 90 days).

Operational asks for Procurement:
- Please draft an IO for $7,500 Redwood sponsorship (line item: "Nimbus Accelerator cohort credits").
- Include promo code issuance workflow and per-team coupon caps in the SOW.
- Reference budget code: PART-2027-ACCEL.

Marcus — can you confirm any additional finance checks? Camila — please prepare the co-marketing blurb once IO is signed.

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: promo-wiring-instructions.pdf (PDF, 200KB)

From: Nina Patel <nina@NimbusAccelerator.org>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@nimbusaccelerator.org
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 12:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus cohort promo request — cohort starting Feb 1

Amazing — thank you, Marissa and team. I attached the signed IO draft (nimbus-signed-IO.pdf) with the $7,500 Redwood sponsorship line item and a short SOW. We prefer individual coupon codes per team (simpler for tracking).

We also request a 45-day trial window extension for cohort participants who sign up via the cohort portal — if Redwood can do 45 days instead of 30 it would help adoption. If not, 30 days is fine.

Can you confirm provisioning timeline? We would like codes ready by Jan 21 to support pre-cohort onboarding.

Best,
Nina

Attachment: nimbus-signed-IO.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@NimbusAccelerator.org>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Nimbus cohort promo request — cohort starting Feb 1

Nina — great, thanks for the signed IO. We will provision individual coupons and we can extend trial windows to 45 days for this cohort as an exception. Procurement will finalize the IO and Accounting will register the spend to PART-2027-ACCEL.

Action items / timeline:
- Jan 15: Procurement issues official IO (Marcus)
- Jan 18: Ops issues individual coupon batch and shares tracking sheet with Nimbus (Camila)
- Jan 21: Codes available to cohort portal; co-marketing blurb live on cohort page (Camila + Marissa)

I attached the internal credit note for tracking (redwood-credit-note.txt). I'll open a provisioning ticket and share the link when live.

Olga
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-credit-note.txt (TXT, 1.2KB)
